verdict.rationale: Supabase is built on standard Postgres and is fully open source, and its self-hosting docs explicitly frame this as enabling 'full control over your data' with the entire stack deployable via Docker Compose in your own infrastructure — strong support for data portability and vendor exit. However, there's no explicit documentation in the evidence pack of a first-class 'export all your data' feature/CLI command (e.g., a documented pg_dump/export workflow, or storage/auth data export tooling beyond backups) as distinct from self-hosting the whole stack. Missing for 10: explicit data-export/dump documentation or tooling, evidence of exporting non-database data (storage files, auth users) in open formats, and independent confirmation of successful migration-out.
